scope: Implement the separately specified serialized shift-period characterization without changing fixed-cascade H3, transformer-only replay, the offline policy or any fitted parameter. The workload contract retains its historical implementation status.
plan: Before startup supply the immutable full ordered request tuple, its authenticated manifest byte hash, repeat index 1-5 and warmup count 1000. Smaller plans are software fixtures only. This HTTP layer checks the plan's structure and service/client agreement, not upstream source completeness or the truth of a caller-supplied hash.
owner: Construct LiveMonitor inside open_bound_session on the existing sole scoring owner. Authenticate models before entry; retain all post-restoration binding checks. No second numerical context, fitting path or URL fetching is added.
admission: Admit only the exact next occurrence ID and raw URL in the warmup or measured plan. At most one scan is unresolved at the scorer. Reject extra, duplicate, reordered, mismatched or concurrently unresolved rows; stream-order violations and scoring failures make the stream permanently incomplete. Existing v1 scan and drain wire fields are unchanged.

controls.POST /v1/shift/state: An owner-queue barrier returns workload/plan identity, phase, broken/completion flags, drained counters and private ordered live trace. State is not a research completion receipt.
controls.POST /v1/shift/reset: Accept exactly the entire ordered warmup occurrence-ID list once. Fence those IDs before the owner barrier. Require every warmup row admitted and completed without scoring failure. Clear monitor ring, position, activation and warmup trace only; preserve physical and service counters and the numerical session. A failed or measured stream cannot be reset.

live_scoring: Route from prior alerts; call the original selective singleton scorer once. Independently derive the 25 raw-URL features and the separately frozen portable Logistic-L1 probability for GMM feature 26; do not substitute the authoritative detector probability. Execute singleton GMM NLL, then the original float64 numpy.mean on each complete 256-row window at stride 64. Strict boundary exceedance ending at t activates only t+1 through t+256. Retain at most 256 NLLs in monitor state; complete trace storage is separate private evidence.
failures: Any scorer, monitor or window computation failure poisons the live stream. A post-classifier monitor failure can leave the base scorer's completed counter incremented; the HTTP owner separately records that request as failed. Do not roll back counters, advance missing rows, resume, reset poison or retry an occurrence.
client: Use the same loopback-only HTTP/1.1 client, no retries, one connection and 2000ms total scan deadline. After every terminal scan error, fence/drain that occurrence before another scan. Continue only if it was admitted in sequence and completed successfully at the owner; retain the client error. Missing/admission/scoring failures stop the run. Final controls and validation failures retain collected warmup/measured outcomes as incomplete evidence.
timing: Scan latency excludes controls. Measured phase wall time includes inline post-error drains because subsequent arrivals wait for them; report their duration separately. Final drain and final trace serialization are outside measured phase wall time and per-request latency. The elapsed interval must cover the sum of serialized request latencies plus inline drain intervals. Report N per repeat, never primary H3's 10000/50000 denominators.
integrity: Validate exact occurrence/source/admission order, all counters, trace positions, complete-window means, future-only activations and response/trace agreement. Then independently compare live probabilities where evaluated, NLLs, windows, flags and decisions with authenticated offline full-stream evidence. A client summary without this comparison and successful bound-process shutdown is not an accepted research result.
remaining: Verified source adapters and realized complete external manifest
Process-isolated official producer, attempt reservation and durable result publication
Secondary method implementations and fitted-artifact freeze
Exclusive hardware and complete pre-access review
